profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Disney | Ex-NYT, Ex-Visa
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Engineer at The Walt Disney Company, I contribute to innovative projects that align with the organization’s mission of delivering exceptional experiences. With a solid foundation in Computer Science from the University of Southern California, I bring a blend of technical expertise and a collaborative approach to support impactful software development initiatives.  

My prior experience includes leading large-scale cloud migrations and re-architecting high-scale messaging platforms at The New York Times. I specialize in backend architecture, event-driven systems, and utilizing technologies such as AWS, GCP, and generative AI tools to enhance workflows, scalability, and resilience.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building out the Ads organization's in-house AI Platform for MCP and Agentic solutions.

Keywords: LangChain, LangGraph, Kubernetes, Aurora, DynamoDB, AWS Bedrock Agentcore, MCP

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected event-driven workflows in NYT’s high-scale messaging platform (MEMO), leveraging AWS services to deliver ~60B push notifications and ~27B emails annually.

Led large-scale cloud migrations from GCP to AWS, improving scalability, observability, and maintainability.

Migrated messaging platform from a distributed monolith to a microservice, event-driven architecture, increasing resilience and development velocity.

Partnered with NYT Games to launch a “streak saver” push notification for Wordle, preserving daily streaks and boosting engagement.

Championed adoption of generative AI tools (including Cursor) to improve documentation, project discovery, and implementation workflows.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Terraform · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Generative AI Tools

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Building the future of Visa’s transaction processing capabilities as part of Open Visa Net (OVN) using open-source software.
•	Collaborating with the Tools & Automation team to further develop the OVN Testing Toolkit (OVNTT); leveraging Go to enable parallel end-to-end (E2E) test execution.
•	Spearheading the development of a standalone application that simulates Visa’s A.I. platform and its integration with OVNTT.
•	Created and maintain the primary Jenkins pipeline used by the Test Engineering team to run automated E2E tests to catch issues throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC).
•	Developed a reporting tool that aggregates E2E test results, creates Jira tickets for failing tests, and generates JSON structured test execution summary to display results in OVN’s SDLC dashboard.
•	Automated test engineer’s test management by developing an automatic conversion tool between test files and Excel Sheet to enable bulk test upload to the Zephyr for Jira test management system.
•	Developed and executed behavior driven development tests using OVNTT ensuring OVN meets Visa’s business requirements.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant -- ITP 380 Video Game Programming
positions.description:
Held weekly office hours to answer student's questions and help with class assignments
Graded and code reviewed student's programming assignments

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a domain specific language (DSL) using open source technologies Xtext and Xtend.
Developed an IDE to support the DSL with features such as 
•	syntax highlighting
•	file formatting
•	code autocomplete 
•	integration with other Visa domain specific languages
IDE increased the productivity of Visa Test Engineer by making it easier to write their end-to-end test cases.

positions.title: Student Intern
positions.description:
•	Designed software architecture for a scalable data collection system capable of handling SPI transfer data from several Raspberry Pi’s and presented the data in an easy-to-read format.
•	Developed a C library to integrate software API running on a Debian Linux OS and pre-existing test framework.
•	Presented overview of the software architecture to JPL Section Supervisors and Group Supervisors and explained the software choices made and system work-flow
